Add the local proxy: selectors, server, forwarder, chat

The local proxy serves /v1/messages and /v1/chat/completions from
upstreams that speak the Messages API, behind a local access key, with
per-upstream credential selection and failover. Everything that runs is
thyrox code; the executable's gateway, CLIProxyAPI and OmniRoute were
read as design references only, and the proxy tests pass with no
Claude Code on PATH.

- credentialSelectors: fill-first, round-robin by identity successor,
  smooth weighted round-robin, priority tiers and model cooldown.
- server: access, routing, failover ranking (429 > 401/403 > 404 >
  501 > 502), security headers and request id.
- upstreamForwarder: HTTP forward with the client header allowlist,
  credential auth (api key or OAuth), a first-byte deadline joined to
  the client signal, response header filtering and an SSRF guard on
  every request.
- startServer: Bun.serve on loopback only; refuses to start without a
  local key, since the proxy carries upstream credentials.
- translators and chatCompletions: OpenAI Chat Completions to and from
  the Messages API, streaming included, tool names restored.

Every guard has its annulment control: removing it drops exactly the
case that depends on it. Results in the proxy bench README.
